Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto

Class BorrowRequestDto

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto.BorrowRequestDto
public class BorrowRequestDto extends Object
Represents a borrow request for a game. Stores details about the request, including the requester, game, and status.

    • BorrowRequestDto

      public BorrowRequestDto(int id, int requesterId, int requestedGameId, Date startDate, Date endDate, String status, Date requestDate)
      Constructs a new borrow request DTO.
      Parameters:
      id - Unique ID of the request.
      requesterId - ID of the user making the request.
      requestedGameId - ID of the game being requested.
      startDate - Start date of the borrow period.
      endDate - End date of the borrow period.
      status - Current status of the request (e.g., pending, approved, declined).
      requestDate - Date when the request was made.
